subject: Cross meter case with your MPAN: 2700007910880

messages.content: Hello, the difficult part about this cross meter case is that all meters are inside each individual flat. Your MPAN and mine are crossed in terms of the DCC, the ESME and CHFs are incorrect. However, this is at least a 3 way cross, and I need your cooperation to find out more.

Good Afternoon - Hope you're all well, and many apologies, but we're still waiting for a reply off our customer for confirmation of his SMART serial meter number, so not sure if you can help in advising us off your customer contact/comments to if the meters are in a communal position/room on site, as if it is accessible, I may be able to arrange a metering visit to meet someone on site, (not sure if there is a front desk concierge on site ?), once apologies for the delay caused, Ian 0116 296 3131

Hi team,

Can you please update us on this to avoid further escalation?
Thanks for the update, no worries
no update from our customer - have mailed them again to confirm their meter details for apartment 2302 - Thanks Ian
Good Afternoon, hope you're all well, and many thanks for the mail, will contact our customer to check the details for you - many thanks Ian
Hi, please ask our customer to do burns test and check. We have conducted our engineer visit already. Please do yours.

Hi team, our customer has MPAN: 2700007910844 and MSN: 22L4087640. But burns test result shows that it is not recording their consumption. We are receiving remote reads from a smart meter linked to your customer with MPAN: 2700007910880, which also does not align with our customer's usage. Please check with your customer at Apartment 2302 if their meter is crossed.
